fields.description: Four-digit year of the birth. Example: 1975.
fields.name: source_year

fields.description: Four-digit year of the birth. Example: 1975.
fields.name: year

fields.description: Month index of the date of birth, where 1=January.
fields.name: month

fields.description: Day of birth, starting from 1.
fields.name: day

fields.description: Day of the week, where 1 is Sunday and 7 is Saturday.
fields.name: wday

fields.description: The two character postal code for the state. Entries after 2004 do not include this value.
fields.name: state

fields.description: TRUE if the child is male, FALSE if female.
fields.name: is_male

fields.description:
The race of the child. One of the following numbers:

1 - White
2 - Black
3 - American Indian
4 - Chinese
5 - Japanese
6 - Hawaiian
7 - Filipino
9 - Unknown/Other
18 - Asian Indian
28 - Korean
39 - Samoan
48 - Vietnamese
fields.name: child_race

fields.description: Weight of the child, in pounds.
fields.name: weight_pounds

fields.description: How many children were born as a result of this pregnancy. twins=2, triplets=3, and so on.
fields.name: plurality

fields.description: Apgar scores measure the health of a newborn child on a scale from 0-10. Value after 1 minute. Available from 1978-2002.
fields.name: apgar_1min

fields.description: Apgar scores measure the health of a newborn child on a scale from 0-10. Value after 5 minutes. Available from 1978-2002.
fields.name: apgar_5min

fields.description: The two-letter postal code of the mother's state of residence when the child was born.
fields.name: mother_residence_state

fields.description: Race of the mother. Same values as child_race.
fields.name: mother_race

fields.description: Reported age of the mother when giving birth.
fields.name: mother_age

fields.description: The number of weeks of the pregnancy.
fields.name: gestation_weeks

fields.description: Date of the last menstrual period in the format MMDDYYYY. Unknown values are recorded as "99" or "9999".
fields.name: lmp

fields.description: True if the mother was married when she gave birth.
fields.name: mother_married

fields.description: The two-letter postal code of the mother's birth state.
fields.name: mother_birth_state

fields.description: True if the mother smoked cigarettes. Available starting 2003.
fields.name: cigarette_use

fields.description: Number of cigarettes smoked by the mother per day. Available starting 2003.
fields.name: cigarettes_per_day

fields.description: True if the mother used alcohol. Available starting 1989.
fields.name: alcohol_use

fields.description: Number of drinks per week consumed by the mother. Available starting 1989.
fields.name: drinks_per_week

fields.description: Number of pounds gained by the mother during pregnancy.
fields.name: weight_gain_pounds

fields.description: Number of children previously born to the mother who are now living.
fields.name: born_alive_alive

fields.description: Number of children previously born to the mother who are now dead.
fields.name: born_alive_dead

fields.description: Number of children who were born dead (i.e. miscarriages)
fields.name: born_dead

fields.description: Total number of children to whom the woman has ever given birth (includes the current birth).
fields.name: ever_born

fields.description: Race of the father. Same values as child_race.
fields.name: father_race

fields.description: Age of the father when the child was born.
fields.name: father_age

fields.description: 1 or 2, where 1 is a row from a full-reporting area, and 2 is a row from a 50% sample area.
fields.name: record_weight
